name: znetwork_send_packet_reliable
description: zNetwork::SendPacketReliable dispatches to the synchronous or async reliable DirectPlay send path based on the TCP/IP async-send flag.
known_limits: The smoke uses a fake DirectPlay provider for both dispatch paths; tier S verification is deferred to a zNetwork source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48c080 validates dispatch on g_zNetwork_TcpIpAsyncSendEnabled, packet-size load from header offset 2, and tail calls to reliable Send or SendExReliable.
The native zNetwork packet-send smoke verifies the synchronous reliable path, async reliable path, packet-size forwarding, flags, and provider error handling.
